tooling.scope: optional general read-only tools, never a substitute for analyst discovery or real runtime trace

execution_contract: Begin five role-bound research investigations against the same common P0; specialize scope and apply only assigned algorithms.
Each specialist must document exact raw question, SQL literal, returned values or exact SQLSTATE error, source epoch and references, causal alternatives, omissions and falsifiers.
Freeze each of five role RAW files and read back their exact SHA before running the synthesizer.
The synthesizer may access only the five RAW reports of THIS arm, not results of other arms or evaluator.
Preserve concrete typed caller/callee identity evidence; a count-only summary cannot substitute for a material relation witness or a justified unknown.
Freeze independent-arm RAW and synthesis before any score; external judge separately evaluates.
Do not infer that passing a deterministic method check proves the four hidden discoveries or material runtime improvement.
producer_allowlist: Current input packet and linked common P0 source event 20161
Method-specific B+D or B+C+E modules and the actual registered roles
The generic reverse-consumer method/helper and existing M0.3 reusable infrastructure (but NOT its historical source counts as case facts)
Authorized READ-ONLY SQL and canonical same-case historical evidence, with CURRENT readbacks clearly marked
producer_denylist: Any transcript/report/summary with target answers, H1-H4 scoring or judge hints
Other arm CURRENT role outputs or synthesis
Any post-cutoff fact presented as if historical P0
